rawFindings.title: Incorrect calculation of replacement text range in report function causing wrong fix behavior
rawFindings.explanation: The code changed the calculation of the text range to replace during auto-fix from a formula based on node.range and lastNodeCheckEndOffset to one based on node.loc.start/end columns and indent counts. However, node.loc columns represent character positions in line, not indices in the source code string, so using these directly to form ranges for fixer.replaceTextRange is incorrect and can cause the fix to corrupt the code or fail silently.
rawFindings.suggestion:
Revert the changed lines in the report function to use the original logic that computes the text range using node.range and lastNodeCheckEndOffset, which is a correct absolute index range in the source code text. Specifically, restore these lines:

lastNodeCheckEndOffset = lastNodeCheckEndOffset || 0;
